REQUIRED SUBMISSION ATTACHMENTS FOR PERMANENT SIGN PERMITS: 
1. For all signs, a drawing of the sign, colored rendering including the message, drawn to scale, showing the dimensions of the sign. 
2. For all free-standing signs, a site plan of the property showing the location of each proposed sign and distance to property lines and street right-
of-way. 
3. For all free-standing signs, foundation drawings, stamped and sealed by an architect or engineer, detailing footer depth & width and structural
loads as required by the Ohio Building Code. 
4. For all wall mounted signs, details of how the sign will be attached to the wall of the structure where proposed.
